## Overview

Atrial fibrillation is the condition common to every trial in this corpus. The sources describe a population with atrial fibrillation who are at increased risk for stroke and distinguish a nonvalvular form ([src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md), [src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228.md)).

## Outcome framework used in the sources

- Primary efficacy end point: stroke or systemic embolism ([src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63.md)).
- Principal safety end point: major bleeding, with intracranial hemorrhage and gastrointestinal bleeding reported as secondary outcomes ([src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_68f0cec57cbc9a18bfbd4cfce07d3b63.md), [src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md)).
